description:
You've just walked into a kitchen.

You make out a closed fridge. You can make out a closed oven, which looks conventional, in the room. You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a table. Why don't you take a picture of it, it'll last longer! The table is massive. On the table you make out a cookbook and a knife, so there's that.
